project_context.target_audience: Families and businesses in Poltava, Ukraine seeking reliable, premium moving services.
project_context.key_values: Trust, speed, careful handling, premium service, zero stress.

theme_and_archetype.reasoning: A light theme evokes transparency and trust, essential for residential moving. High-contrast Swiss layout brings authority and clarity. We are swapping the traditional tech colors for a 'Navy & Amber' palette to maintain the original site's orange brand recognition but elevating it to a premium level.

rules: Use #EA580C (Amber/Orange) STRICTLY for CTAs (Call Now, Request Callback). It must be the most visible element.
Never use generic flat gray for backgrounds. Use tinted greys (slate).
Avoid #000000. Use deep navy/slate (#0B1120) for primary text.
Both fonts MUST support Cyrillic characters perfectly.
Headings (Unbounded): Use tracking-tight for titles to give a premium, solid 'cargo' feel.
Do NOT use Inter for headings.
H1 size max text-5xl md:text-6xl. Use fluid scaling.

spacing_and_layout.strategy: Generous Spacing + 'Control Room' Grid for Services
spacing_and_layout.card_style: Sharp edges or minimal border-radius (rounded-sm). 1px solid border (#E2E8F0). No heavy drop shadows. Rely on crisp borders.
grid_patterns: Fleet Section: 3-column comparative layout for Mini, Standard, Maxi trucks.

navigation.style: Crystal Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-slate-200). Sticky top.

mobile_sticky_cta.description: CRITICAL: Fixed button at the bottom of the viewport on mobile devices ('Замовити дзвінок' / 'Зателефонувати') to drive Google Ads conversions.
mobile_sticky_cta.classes: fixed bottom-4 left-4 right-4 z-50 bg-orange-600 text-white shadow-lg rounded-full py-4 text-center font-bold

forms.integration: Send to Telegram API (implement mock fallback `console.log('Sending to Telegram...')` if no API key is present).
forms.pricing_rule: DO NOT SHOW EXACT PRICES. The copy should emphasize 'Отримайте індивідуальний прорахунок' (Get a custom quote).

patterns: Fade up with stagger for service cards and fleet items.
Smooth scroll between sections using `lenis` if applicable.

hero_background.description: Moving truck parked. Apply a gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-r from-slate-900/90 to-slate-900/40) so the white/orange text pops perfectly.

movers_action.description: Professional movers carrying boxes. Use in About Us or Services section.

icons.instructions: Use lucide-react for all service icons (e.g., Truck, Package, Home, Building, Trash2, Sofa, Piano/Music, Wrench).

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the entire website copy is strictly in Ukrainian.
Use react-router-dom to create actual separate routes for the 8 services.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, and forms for testing purposes.
Prioritize mobile performance. Ensure the sticky CTA doesn't cover footer links.
Do not use generic 'card' wrappers for everything; use CSS grid with crisp borders for the Swiss look.
Form submission should have a mock Telegram API integration using console.log or a mock promise.
